Name: Puzzle Quest 2
Description: A match-three puzzle game wrapped in a role-playing campaign, where matching gems casts the spells in turn-based duels.

Achievements.Name: Save Verloren
Achievements.Description: Save the town of Verloren from invading Goblins and Trolls

Achievements.Name: PWNT!
Achievements.Description: Defeat an opponent on your first turn during any single player game mode

Achievements.Name: Cheating AI
Achievements.Description: Be defeated by an opponent on their first turn during any single player game mode

Achievements.Name: Epic Win
Achievements.Description: Defeat an opponent while on 1 Life Point during any single player game mode

Achievements.Name: Epic Fail
Achievements.Description: Lose to an opponent while on 1 Life Point during any single player game mode

Achievements.Name: OMGHAX
Achievements.Description: Make a match of 8 gems in a row in any battle game mode

Achievements.Name: Gate Hacker
Achievements.Description: Use the Bash mini-game to destroy every locked gate, door or chest possible!

Achievements.Name: King Godd
Achievements.Description: Defeat King Godd and complete the 'King Godd' quest

Achievements.Name: Shadowbringer
Achievements.Description: Defeat the Shadowbringer and complete the 'Shadowbringer' quest

Achievements.Name: Abominable
Achievements.Description: Defeat the Yeti and complete the challenge quest

Achievements.Name: Dragonslayer
Achievements.Description: Defeat the Green Dragon and complete the challenge quest
